96114: A coolheaded dreamer from the countryside. Originally hailing from the countryside, she enrolled in Tracen Academy after dominating the racing scene back home. She works to make her hometown proud, but try as she might, her clumsy side always comes out.
125298: The silent runner aiming to break the sound barrier. An Umamusume seen as a prodigy who's always ahead of the pack, both figuratively and literally. She gets so absorbed with running that she comes off as aloof, but most know that she is dedicated.
125299: Rar'n to go! A pure-hearted girl focused on her dream. Born in Hokkaido, Special Week is a bright and cheery, hardworking Umamusume. After losing her birth mother, Special Week was raised by her mother's friend.
125300: Unbeatable and adorable! A happy hoppin' racer. A bright, bubbly Umamusume with a natural knack for racing. She's long looked up to the student council president, Symboli Rudolf, and this admiration serves as her ultimate motivation in becoming the number one racer.
125301: Beyond arrogant! This hothead hates to lose. Unyielding, strong-willed, and cheeky, she wants to be number one at everything she does. She usually plays the role of the perfect, mild-mannered honor student, but the truth is that she hates losing more than anything else.
125303: The North American Phantom Bird! A vivacious and quirky lucha libre. A masked luchadora, she's always hyped up and ready to wrestle. She has ultimate confidence that she's the world's strongest Umamusume, and loves to proclaim that fact to anyone who'll lend her an ear.
125304: Headstrong and full of life! A roadster with a heart of gold. Dedicated to being the coolest, this Umamusume tries her best to act like a delinquent. She takes after her motorcycle-loving father, emulating his hobbies and attitudes down to the letter.
125305: Wild and unpredictable, this golden runner is unlike anybody else! An unpredictable firebrand born with an extra helping of free spirit.
125309: The crown jewel of the prestigious Mejiro clan. A classy and poised young lady. Born into a family of racing legends, Mejiro McQueen is a long-distance runner who is the envy of her peers.
125310: Does what she wants, when she wants. As free as a drifting cloud... As one of the most easygoing girls you'll meet, she lives life at her own pace. But on the inside, she's quite the schemer, and her laziness is just an act to get others to let down their guard... sometimes.
140842: Keeping it old-school! A real hot rod! A dashing Umamusume with a sisterly demeanor and a retro way of speaking. She is a speed demon who adores the pure joy of the wind in her face.
140843: Actions speak louder than words! A tough and stubborn lone wolf. A member of team Rigil. A lone wolf of few words and ample strength, Narita Brian is feared throughout the academy due to both her personality and her performance on the turf.
140844: The reigning Emperor. Her rule is absolute! Well-versed in both ways of racing and leadership through her work leading the student body, she serves as the evenhanded president of the student council at Tracen Academy.
140845: The pompous star of the stage. Her laugh fills the room! Opera O's behavior is always over-exaggerated, sometimes loudly, and you will often hear her proclaiming her greatness in some way or other.
140846: The coolly calculating Empress. Highly gifted and ambitious. The vice president of Tracen Academy's student council, known to the other students as the "Empress".
140847: Always at your service. The classiest racer around. A dashing performer who never hesitates to take another runner gently by the hand. You won't catch her flirting, however. Instead, she helps her dear ponies in her capacity as leader of Ritto Dormitory.
140848: Neat and sweet. Japanese at heart, she's back home from the U.S. Though born in America, her parents' love of Japanese culture influenced her to also love all things to do with the country—to the point of being called the spitting image of the ideal Japanese beauty.
140849: A friendly girl born in the U.S. A cowgirl with a heart as big as her might. As friendly as they come, she's one heck of a hug machine. She tends to get lonely, however, so perhaps that's why she's one heck of a party planner too!
140850: You wanna go? One-on-one! The dorm leader everyone knows and loves. A hot-blooded racer who loves nothing more than a one-on-one fight. Though seen by most as a fierce competitor, she has the good grace to congratulate her opponents should they win.
164139: Extremely haughty. Her pride extends to the heavens! An Umamusume with an unbreakable spirit, King Halo is ready to overcome any challenge in order to be recognized by all as a first-class lady.
174851: A fiery intellectual. Logic is her weapon! A theorist through and through, she breaks down any problem systemically. Theory-driven as she is, she values practical application, so her methods never end up as just talk.
174852: Never hold back your feelings! This girl wears her heart on her sleeve. Loud and proud, she's a straightforward soul who can get along well with anyone.
200350: Don't expect much from her. This Umamusume is super cynical. An Umamusume of humble background with a penchant for being pessimistic.
203217: A live broadcast announcer for races in the Twinkle Series.
211554: Nothing beats a good workout! Even the sweat of her brow is earnest and pure. A sporty girl who loves a good workout. Although born into the prestigious Mejiro family, her animated personality somewhat betrays that fact.
211555: She wants to change! This Umamusume bears the scars of her past. While cool and reticent, she remains tense in many social situations, especially if men are present.
211557: In order to change her outlook and herself, this pessimist gives it her all. Her self-esteem droops as low as her ears. Things never seem to go quite right for this clumsy girl.
211560: A plucky umamusume who is a true child of Edo though she actually comes from the countryside. She’s small, but possesses infinite power and stamina. Her strength was unmatched in her local series, and she was known as the “Downtown Superstar.
211561: Fortune be with me! This charm-tastic Umamusume loves fortune-telling. A fortune-telling fanatic and lover of the supernatural, she's content to leave the outcomes of races and many other things up to luck.
211565: Motherly and kind, her presence is soothing. No matter how bad you were, this racer will forgive and comfort you before spoiling you rotten. Her tendency towards leniency sometimes extends to herself. She values the growth of others over even her own personal gains.
211567: Her comebacks are lightning fast. Showin' 'em what Naniwa girls are made of! A small girl with an unmistakable Kansai dialect. Despite her size, she's a bundle of energy and is always ready for action, be it in a race or in everyday life.
211570: Everything she does is according to her plan. A solemn and diligent mädchen. A diligent and methodical exchange student from Germany. Everything she does is planned an scheduled down to the second.
211768: No matter how many times she falls, this girl always picks herself back up! She's on a losing streak... but she never gives up! While she may not be the most skilled, she experienced the excitement of racing back in Kochi and wanted more.
